name: orchestrator.search_similar
description: Search for similar past tool executions or episodes using natural language. Finds historically similar operations by embedding similarity.

query.description: Natural language description of what to search for (e.g., 'create walls along an axis', 'duct routing failures')

search_type.description: Search across full episodes (agentic loops) or individual tool events

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

doc_guid.description: Optional: filter to a specific Revit document GUID

results.description: Matching results with card_text, similarity score, and outcome
